symptoms: Vibration rose from 2.1 to 6.9 mm/s over about two weeks, with bearing housing temperature up 4 C.
root_cause: Worn drive-end and non-drive-end bearings due to degraded grease.
action_taken: Isolated pump, replaced both bearings, rechecked alignment, regreased.
outcome: Vibration returned to 2.0 mm/s and has stayed stable.

symptoms: Casing temperature rose from 70 C to 88 C over ten days; motor current up about 8 percent.
root_cause: Intercooler filter blocked with debris, reducing coolant flow.
action_taken: Cleaned the intercooler and replaced the cooler filter.
outcome: Temperature back to 70 C within one hour of restart.

fault: Pump seal leakage with pressure loss
symptoms: Discharge pressure fell from 6.0 to 4.6 bar over two weeks with a small leak at the gland.
action_taken: Replaced the mechanical seal kit, inspected shaft sleeve, flushed seal line.
outcome: Pressure restored to 6.0 bar; leak stopped.

symptoms: Vibration rose from 1.8 to 6.2 mm/s and frame temperature rose 5 C over twelve days.
root_cause: Bearing wear with slight coupling misalignment.
action_taken: Replaced both bearings and realigned the coupling.
